race.comment: KAAZI (1) draws a soft gate for his return. It is a nice distance to kick off at for a horse who can get to 2000m. Might prefer it on the softer side but should be ready after a couple of trials. VLTAVA (4) has some solid Highway form in Sydney which could be handy. Kicked off the campaign with a win at this track three back. Looks well placed. CURRUMBIN ALLEY (3) was beaten less than 2L when resuming. Fitter and the longer trip should suit. MOANA GOLD (9) is another that should be better with a run under the belt and is two for two at this longer trip.
